upgradeWarning: Back up before upgrading. Request ids are stored differently from this release on, so going back to an older version needs that backup

changes.text: new media server: tofa, with live sessions, library, history import and its built-in requests
connect a tofa server by signing in to tofa, in setup or Settings → Servers, with no API key to paste
the owner and members can sign in with their tofa account, with its own switch under Settings → Access → Sign-in
a tofa server needs version 0.13.3 or newer
first-run setup walks through signing in, connecting a server and importing history
option under Settings → Access → Sign-in to make single sign-on the only way admins and members sign in
Jellyfin plays the server sends unchanged show as Direct Play, even when the client reports Direct Stream
Jellyfin music no longer shows a video transcode, and a remuxed track no longer counts as a transcode
duplicate titles merged in a library sync keep the copy Tracearr added first, so a library always merges the same way
episodes whose TVDB ids differ are no longer merged into one, even with the same IMDb id; earlier merges stay merged
signing out of a single sign-on account returns to the login page instead of the identity provider's logout page
Live TV names the program's show, season and episode, with the channel under the title
Jellyfin and Emby Live TV shows the program on air, where it showed only the channel
Plex Live TV takes the channel and art from the program guide when the session doesn't name them
starting a history import no longer waits on the media server; on a new server it waits for the first library sync
a failed import tries again on its own, 3 attempts in all; a rejected key fails at once and shows the reason
Add Server offers the same history import step as first-run setup
Library and Tasks show a new server's first sync while it's queued, and a toast says if it fails for good
Settings → Servers → Connections rows have one Sync button and one menu, with status shown as badges
people lists keep each person's Tracearr name under a server filter, not a media server account's name
a Jellyfin or Emby server re-added at its address syncs its libraries right away
with two servers of one type, import progress shows only under the server being imported
